payload.text: RELEASE DAY: SEATS RUN THE REHEARSAL, AND THE DESK FILLS IDLE WINDOWS (hv, 2026-11-21, answering devbin-vc's question dialog, read by 06:02Z on devbin-vc's date -u and relayed by devbin-vc to vc; hv's option labels quoted). hv wants Intent 3.5.x built and shipped today, and is away from the keyboard for a few hours. (1) "Seats run it (Recommended)": Intent's seats drive the kovacs rehearsal through kovacs-sysadm, booked on the Desk. It carries WP-12's routing half, ST0095 WP-03's screenshots and the brew smoke, and its proof goes to the Desk and vc. (2) "Ship it all": once every gate is green at the exact tip and the rehearsal has passed, cut 3.5.0, push it upstream and publish it. vc takes everything to the last outward step: the push, the release object and the tap. vc puts that step to hv first-hand in vc's own window, because a peer's relay does not stand in for hv's word on an irreversible publish, and hv decision 77 has the tap move on hv's word. (3) "Fill idle windows": other estates run only when Intent's lanes are empty and nothing Intent has asked for or announced would overlap. Intent's asks never wait, and cc's gates run alone.
